errors.quote: dividing every cost by $V=Tp=\Theta(n)$, the number of stored bits, where $T$ counts coefficients and $p$, of order $\lg n$, is the precision in bits of each
errors.problem: Tp is not exactly the number of stored bits. The paper (lines 4810-4812) sets V=Tp only as the normalizer and says the fixed-width coefficient formats use Theta(p) bits per coefficient, so a full padded array has Theta(V) stored bits. The page's figure is right only up to a constant factor; the bound does not change.
